intro: Snowbound is a local delivery quest in Loch Modan undertaken on behalf of Grenhild, who is studying local elementals. Her former mentor, Norric Lochthane, requested a jar of unmelted snow gathered from South Gate Pass for his shamanic workings. Delivering the chilly reagent reveals the enduring personal bond and quiet longing between an aging shaman and his former student.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: My old mentor, Norric, sent a minor elemental with an odd request. He needs a jar of snow for some of his shamanic workings! I don't know what he's going to do with that, but I learned a long time ago not to question his ways with respect to magic.

I'm busy learning about the local elementals, so I can't leave to help him. Go to the tunnel entrance at South Gate Pass where there's snow year-round. Scoop some up in this ceramic jar and bring it to him before it melts. The jar should keep it cold.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Snow! Grenhild did it! She sent the snow that I asked for!
A pity, though, I was hoping she would come and visit in person.
Well, regardless, thank you for your effort. This is a real help for my work.
